reason: The cited lines read local host files under project_path (or cwd), including node_modules/next/package.json and package.json, and return derived values such as the Next version/source and docs availability, so they establish host-file data entering the agent context. They do not show arbitrary code execution or sending agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination. Because the returned version data comes from project files at a caller-supplied path, those file contents can be attacker-controlled, so UNTRUSTED is supported.
